# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old by Volume 3.  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 c27 P8](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a round-faced boy with a cheerful, uneven smile, a single dimple in one cheek, and a snub nose. He has a head covered in tiny, fuzzy, yellow ringlets and bright, roguish hazel eyes. He is energetic and mischievous, often ending up coated in dirt or mud.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Robin is a highly energetic, impulsive, and inquisitive boy who is constantly seeking excitement and getting into mischief. He is affectionate and candid, often forming strong bonds with those around him, such as Nell, whom he adores. Though prone to stubbornness and logical rationalizations for his misbehavior, he feels genuine remorse when he realizes he has caused real distress or done wrong. He possesses a competitive and lively spirit, taking great interest in games, outdoor activities, and boyish rivalries.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P23](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0023), [v1 c18 P26](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0026), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c8 P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 c10 P42](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0042), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

## History

Robin grew up in Nova Scotia as part of a large family with several sets of twins. After his mother, Mary Farrow, fell severely ill, he and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters. During his stay, Robin frequently engaged in dramatic antics, such as helping Nell treat Posy Fay Pembroke for croup during a winter storm. He later attended Brierley school, where he formed a rivalry-turned-friendship with Milty Gammon and developed a desire to match the good manners of Cedric Stanhope. Following his mother's death, Robin and Lucy permanently resided at Grey Shutters under Thirza's and Nell's care, periodically causing uproar in the community through various escapades like placing a toad in Thirza's bed, dropping a caterpillar down a girl's collar at church, and locking his sister in a toolhouse.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034)_
